summary: With ansible-core 2.20, the INJECT_FACTS_AS_VARS deprecation makes every use of a variable loaded by community.sops.load_vars show a warning. Set INJECT_FACTS_AS_VARS=true explicitly to silence it, and don't move SOPS vars to ansible_facts. A fix is expected in core 2.21.
questions: Why do I get deprecation warnings every time I use a SOPS-loaded variable?
How do I silence INJECT_FACTS_AS_VARS warnings with community.sops?
Should I switch my SOPS variables to ansible_facts?

answer_card.title: SOPS load_vars warnings on ansible-core 2.20
answer_card.answer_md:
On ansible-core 2.20, variables from `community.sops.load_vars` trigger an `INJECT_FACTS_AS_VARS` deprecation warning on every use. To silence it, explicitly set `INJECT_FACTS_AS_VARS` to `true`, for example `inject_facts_as_vars = True` under `[defaults]` in `ansible.cfg`.

**Don't** move SOPS-encrypted variables to `ansible_facts`. A proper API is expected in core 2.21.
